content: Ciiga Kǝristi ma gǝtlaha
Ndakwan ci zaraabahara, ǝn naagaan ǝn dzamkurnǝs kǝ ǝlbǝg marawǝn kwa tagankur naiyina, kwa dlǝghama nǝ uuramna, dlaɓa kwa famdǝghǝrǝt nǝ uuram tǝ vakaiya.
Tlamkǝna tǝdvad ǝlbǝg marawǝn nǝ uuram kǝ katǝga, ma ba hǝkyamnahǝkyǝg kǝ ǝlbǝgǝn tagankur naiyin ba marawa. Akwama ma maay ndǝkwah biya, fadghǝraruwa ba gyaagyaana.
Dǝgiti dlǝghana naiya, iin wa vǝlankur naiya, kwa maraw ba vaivaiya, iin taakiya, ǝmtsaǝmtsǝg Kǝristi mbakyarvad haipahaamiyama, band kwa vindavindan ma Kakkaɗa Daadamazhigǝla,
taakiya hǝɗavǝnahǝɗǝga, dlaɓa ciyavantcig tǝ hǝnnga hǝkǝrɗa, bandkwa vindavindan ma Kakkaɗa Daadamazhigǝla,
tsugwatsugw vak Kefasa, ard kǝlaawa tar buwǝna.
Tǝhalakwah kaa ba tsugwatsugw kǝ iin vak kǝ uudah dǝrmǝk dlǝɓ dǝ ghǝr ba daval palla, kyalmahaatǝr ar ba dlaɓ ba dǝ shifǝga, kyalmah dlaɓ ǝmtsaharaǝmtsahǝga.
Kaa tsugwatsugw vak Yakuba, ard zarhaɓǝlga Yesu baɗǝmma.
Tǝhala kwanahaan baɗǝmma, kaa ba tsugwatsugw kǝ iin vakara, aanji ba ǝn zǝra ghǝrdlǝga.
Aɗaba kai wa hǝɗikǝn ma zarhaɓǝlga Yesu, maa dlaikwa bi ɗaa kai kǝ uud dǝ zǝrɓǝlga Yesu biya, aɗaba kai wa vǝlantǝr dlaɗ kǝ yaa dadda gata Daadamazhigǝla.

Amma mbakyarvad hɛrǝrra Daadamazhigǝl wa nanal nai ǝndkwana, dlaɓa hɛrǝrrǝn ɓagghwi nǝ iin na gyagyaan biya, aɗaba januujig aanji kwar kǝ zǝrɓǝlgaha Yesu dǝ tlǝrra, bakǝvakwah kai bi wa ɓaganɓag biya, herǝrra Daadamazhǝgǝl kwa ǝmtaɗ dǝ kaiya.
Aiciya, bi kaiya, bi iitǝra, baɗǝmmamnd kǝm taa ba ǝlbǝg marawa, kwan kǝ ǝlbǝg wa famghǝrǝt nǝ uuram tǝ vakaiya.
Ciig ma gǝtlaha
Akwama ba tagav taaki ciyiitciig Kǝristi ma gǝtlaha, aujilbǝg ka cii kǝ kyalmaru ar taakiya maay ciig ma gǝtlah biyi?
Akwama ba maay ciig ma gǝtlah biya, mbats ciyiit bi Kǝristi ma gǝtlah biya.
Akwama ba ciyiit bi Kǝristi ma gǝtlah biya, mbats taa ǝlbǝg marawamnda ba gyagyaana, fadghǝraru dlaɓa nalnǝg ba gyagyaana.

Nalnǝg taaki, tagamndatag kǝ fiid tǝghǝr kǝ Daadamazhigǝla, aɗaba tagamndatag kǝ ǝlbǝg tǝghǝr kǝ Daadamazhigǝl taakiya cighantciig kǝ Kǝristi, akwama ba cighant biya, bak jiijiir maay ciig ma gǝtlah biya.
Akwama maay ciig ma gǝtlah biya, mbats Kǝristi ndakwani ciyavant bi ma gǝtlah biya.
Akwama ba ciyavant bi Kǝristi biya, mbats fadǝghǝraru ba gyaagyaana, bakǝvakwan am ba ndzǝgaan ba ma haipaharuwa.
Mbats lii ǝmtsahara ma Kǝristi zaharazahǝga.
Akwama fantaara miyam ma Kǝristi ba kwakyarvad ndzǝgan kaltiya, mbats jiyamujig aanji ba war kǝ dǝga zhuwadaala.
Bak jiijiira, ciyavantcig Kǝristi ma gǝtlaha. Iin nǝ dǝga zunngw kǝ ciig ma gǝtlaha. Ba pakkat maradamarǝg wan taakiya lii ǝmtsaharaǝmtsahǝg ar da ciiga.
Sǝghǝv tǝdvad uud tsaw nǝ ǝmtsǝga, bandkwah dlaɓ ciig ma gǝtlah sǝghǝv tǝdvad uuda.
Bandkwa ǝmtsǝg nǝ uud baɗǝm mbakyarvad Adamu, da ciiyav dlaɓ nǝ uud baɗǝm mbakyarvad Kǝristi.
Ma ba war da ciiyav ba kǝ aɗab kǝ aɗaba, Kǝristi dǝga zuungwa, tǝhalakwaha da ciiyav nǝ uudahaan dǝ shifǝg daghuvali da saay nǝ iina.
Kaa da sagaw kǝ halavuwa, da tsǝtǝrdatsǝg nǝ Kǝristi kǝ lii kwarǝga, ard kwarǝga, ard ndzǝɗ baɗǝmma, tǝhalakwaha da gwiyarda kǝ tlǝksǝraan baɗǝm kǝ Daadamazhigǝl Daada.
Aɗaba barari kǝ Kǝristi da ɓagaan kǝ kwarǝga, bamma fatǝrɗǝmfǝg kǝ tlǝghumahaan baɗǝm da ma izhangyil kǝ shigahaana.
Tlǝghumi kwa da ghyǝhav tǝhala, iin nǝ ǝmtsǝga.

Aɗaba tagaatag nǝ ǝlbǝga Daadamazhigǝl taaki, “Fadǝmfǝg Daadamazhigǝl kǝ dǝgitah baɗǝm ma izhagyil kǝ kwarǝgaana.” Kwa taga nǝ iin taaki, “Baɗǝm dǝgitah” fadǝmfǝg ma izhangyil kǝ kwarǝgaana, kwan ba tǝ ɓalaɓal taakiya, maay Daadamazhigǝl kata ghǝraan mavakai biya. Daadamazhigǝl wa fadǝm dǝgitah baɗǝm ma izhangyil kǝ Kǝristi.

Akwama da fadǝmfǝg Daadamazhigǝl kǝ dǝgitah baɗǝm da ma izhagyǝl kwarǝga Kǝristi, tǝhalakwah da ndzan zǝrin damma izhangyil kǝ Daadamazhigǝl kwa fadǝm dǝgitah baɗǝm da ma izhagyil kǝ iina, aɗaba Daadamazhigǝl dǝgit baɗǝm baɗǝmma.

Akwama maay ǝndkwah biya, au wa da ɓag nǝ uudahaana, kwa ɓagavtǝra tsufǝg ma gufka lii ruwararugi? Akwama ba maay ciig ma gǝtlah biya, aujilbǝg ka cii ɓagavtǝra tsufǝg kǝ uudah ma gufka lii ruwararugi?
Aujilbǝg ci kǝskǝmiyam vǝla shifǝgamiyam ba kǝlaa hǝnngi?
Ən nǝghǝganǝghǝg kǝ ǝmtsǝg ba kǝlaa hǝnng zaraabahara, bak jiijiira ǝn tsa ghǝr tǝ kuram ma Kǝrsti Yesu Yaazhigǝlamiyama.

Akawama ɓagamndkǝvaɓag dǝ dǝgtǝghalah ma Afisa, ma tǝ tlatlǝga uuda, au ci paiɗaan vakari? Akwama ba da maay nǝ uud ciig ma gǝtlah biya. “Ba kiyam zǝgaan kiyam hǝɓǝgaana, kiyam da ǝmtsǝg tsaw dlakadur biya?”
Aa valkurda bi nǝ uud biya, “Aɗaba ndzǝgan dǝ kǝlaadah badzǝgaan kǝ hǝnkala jiijiira.”
Asamasaas da tǝ ɗuula dzamaghǝr kalkala, am ɗuuwars kǝ ɓa haipa. Aɗaba kyalmaharu ar sǝrga bi kǝ Daadamazhigǝl biya. Ən tag kwakyarvad ǝn tsǝkura kǝ zhǝruwa.
Vǝghi kwa da ciiyav dǝvakaiya
Ar da ndavǝgan kyalmah taakiya, “Da ciig ndar lii ǝmtsaharamǝmtsahǝgi? Ar da sagal dǝ hulfa kwar kǝ vǝghi?”
Kǝgh dlagǝna! dǝgiti aghaa riiga nǝnng da maay sagal biya bamma ǝmtsaǝmtsǝga.
Dǝgiti agha riiga nǝnnga, gyigyiya iin bi wa da sagal biya, ba hulf kaltiya, bi hulfa hiiya, bi hulfa dǝgiti tlǝrn shaha.
Ba Daadamazhigǝl wa vǝlga vǝgh kǝ hulfiin band kwa naag nǝ iina, ma kwar kǝ hulfa dǝgit ba dǝ vǝghaana.
Ɗǝm bi tlu ar dǝgit pall biya. Uudah ard hulfa dǝgaatǝra, almanaha ard hulfa dǝgaatǝra, ɗiikaha ard hulfa dǝgaatǝra. Kilfah dlaɓa ard hulfa dǝgaatǝra.
Mǝnng hulfa vǝrɗiga ghǝrazhigǝla, mǝnng dlaɓ hulfa dǝga kwa ma haaya. Ndanngǝra dǝga ghǝrazhigǝl shaha, ndanngǝra hulfa dǝga haay dlaɓa shaha.
Ndanngǝra faciya shaha, dǝga kyila shaha, dǝga kwadladlah dlaɓa shaha, mǝnng dlaɓ kwatlǝrǝn kǝ kwadladl shah dǝ kwatlǝrǝn kǝ kwadladl vaka ndanngǝra.
Bandkwah dlaɓ tǝghǝr kǝ ciig ma gǝtlaha, dǝgiti aa riiva dǝ riiga da ǝrtsǝga, dǝgiti aa ciivantciig dlaɓ da maay ǝrtsǝg biya.
Riivariig nǝ iin ma neniga, ciiyavantciig dlaɓ ma ndanngǝra. Riivariig ma maira ndzǝɗa, ciivantciig dlaɓ ma ndzǝɗa.
Riivariig dǝ ndzǝgana vǝgha uudǝra, ciiyavantciig dlaɓ dǝ ndzǝgana vǝgha shiɗkwa. Mǝnng tsaw nǝ vǝgha uudǝra, ba jiijiira mǝnng nǝ vǝgha shiɗkwa.
Vindavindan bandkwah taakiya, “Adamu nǝ uuda zunngwa, nalnǝg kǝ uud dǝ shifǝga.” Adamu dǝga hal iin shǝɗkw kwa vǝlla shifǝga.
Dǝga shiɗkw bi nǝ dǝga zunngw biya, dǝga tluwa ard avǝz lakwti kǝ dǝga shiɗkwa.
Uuda zunngw ndǝrava dǝ haaya, sal ma haaya. Dǝga bu sahi ma ghǝrazhigǝla.
Bandkwa dǝga haay nǝ uuda, ar bandkwah dlaɓ lii ndǝrava dǝ haaya. Lii ar dǝga ghǝrazhigǝla, ar band daddakwa sahii ma ghǝrazhigǝla.
Bandkwa kiyam dǝ dzakǝva daddakwa ndǝrava dǝ haay nǝ miyama, kiyam da nǝg dlaɓ kǝ dzakǝva daddakwa sahii ma ghǝrazhigǝla.
Dǝgiti ǝn tagkur nai zaraabahara, tluwa ard avǝz gwigu bi kǝ tlǝkǝsǝra ghǝrazhigǝl biya, bandkwah dlaɓ daddakwa da ǝrtsǝg da maay gwiya daddakwa maay ǝrtsǝgǝn biya.
Cinngamcinga, ǝn tagkurtag kǝ dǝgiti shiɓashiɓana! Kiyam da maay ǝmtsǝg ɗǝm biya, amma da mbǝɗav nǝ ndzǝgana miyam baɗǝmma,
Ba daval palla, band kǝbǝciga gyiya, aɗaba da fǝrtav dǝrawa, dlaɓa da ciyav lii ǝmtsaharaǝmtsahǝg dǝ vǝgh hulfa kwa da maay ǝrtsǝg biya, da mbǝɗav nǝ ndzǝgana miyama.
Aɗaba barari nǝ vǝghǝn kwa ǝrtsǝgǝna da mbǝɗav nal kwa maay ǝrtsǝg biya, vǝghǝghi kwa da ǝmtsǝga da mbǝɗav nal kwa maay ǝmtsǝg biya.

Tǝhalakwa ma mbǝɗavnambǝɗǝg nǝ vǝghǝn kwa ǝrtsǝgǝn nal kwa maay ǝrtsǝgǝn biya, dlaɓa vǝghǝn kwa dǝga ǝmtsǝgǝn nal kwa maay ǝmtsǝgǝn biya, da righǝg ma sarta kwah nǝ ǝlbǝgǝn vindava ma Kakkaɗa Daadamazhigǝl taakiya, “Ghyihavǝnaghyihǝg nǝ ǝmtsǝga, zavuuzǝg fiir tǝghǝra.
Kǝgh ǝmtsǝga, mǝr za fiiraghi? Kǝgh ǝmtsǝga mǝr nǝ guraghi?”
Gura ǝmtsǝga iin haipa, ndzǝɗa haip iin nǝ adzahadzaha.
Tagiyamartag kǝ uus kǝ Daadamazhigǝl kwa vǝlkiyam fiir tǝdvad Yaazhigǝl Yesu Kǝristi!
Mbakyarvad kwah zaraabahara, ghacamaghacig ba dangala, ba kǝlaa hǝng am ɓagar tlǝr kǝ Kǝristi, aɗaba am sǝran taakiya dlaɗǝn am hǝɓǝg nǝ uuram mbakyarvad Yaazhǝgǝlǝn gyagyaan biya.
